answer.rationale: Use the expiring incumbent contract and the credible low-cost quote as leverage to renegotiate price, payment terms, volume/short-extension protection, and service penalties rather than switching primary supply into a 94%-loaded line with no buffer. The low-cost quote may satisfy the 18% mandate on unit price, but TCO includes onboarding, quality escape, expediting, inventory, and downtime risk; memory_c2 is directly relevant but consolidated and may omit context. memory_c4 supports benchmarking at renewal as the lower-risk path to margin recovery. Deferral risks a supply lapse in 14 days; adding a second source is valuable but cannot resolve the immediate expiry alone.
